note: The curated multi-national employers that make up the work-field company picker's day-one list. Every entry is a well-known company where designers actually work, across the US, Europe and India. `domain` is the registrable email domain the company is known by; it is written to company_domains as an UNVERIFIED hint, so a company appears in the picker and the first member whose work email matches finishes the claim. Consumed by scripts/generate-company-directory-mnc-seed.mjs, which validates it (unique names, unique domains, unique slugs, syntactically valid domains) and generates supabase/migrations/*_company_directory_mnc_seed.sql. Real names and their public website/email domains only; no vendored dataset.
featured_note: Companies shown first in the picker's initial (empty-query) list, in the order they are shown: the design tools, studios, agencies and design-led employers a designer is most likely to look for. Names, not slugs — `loadFeatured` refuses a name that is not in `companies` below, and scripts/generate-company-directory-mnc-seed.test.mjs asserts that supabase/migrations/20261007150000_company_directory_design_first.sql marks exactly these names at exactly these positions (1..N).
